**sdd/issue-266-h1-brain-review/apply-progress**

**What**: H1-5a — the deny-set + poster's `reviewed:stale` fold (standing condition 1) — MERGED update. Prior state stands unchanged: H1-1 (identity/cold-boot/verdict/CLI skeleton, merged PR), H1-2b (port widening), H1-3 (checkpoint, gated on ADR-0022, PR not yet opened), H1-4 (ruling evaluator, PR not yet opened) — see prior revisions, obs #934, for full detail. This revision ADDS the H1-5a slice: implemented REQ-H1-14 (Phase 13, task 13.1, tasks.md) — the hardcoded label deny-set — and folded standing condition 1 (poster.mjs's `reviewed:stale` labelAdd now routes through it). Worktree `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-266-h1-5a`, branch `feat/issue-266-h1-5a-deny-set`, off merged tracker `origin/issue-266`, 8a589f4.

**Why**: Track H, issue #266, phase H1, group H1-5 (queue + board + deny-set). REQ-H1-14 requires the reviewer's authority lock: a hardcoded, fail-closed ALLOW-LIST gate every `labelAdd` passes through, refusing loosen/unlock labels (`status:approved`, `size:exception`, `skip:*`, `override:*`) BEFORE the provider is ever reached — the deny-set is the first line, `actor-check` (L5) is the independent backstop (protocol §9, design.md §7). Split from H1-5 (queue.mjs, task 12.1) and H1-5b (board.mjs, cli wiring, task 13.2/13.3) to keep this slice small and security-focused. Also fulfills issue #266 comment 5004345710's condition ("the constant is the seed, not the fence") by folding poster.mjs's pre-existing `reviewed:stale` label add under the same gate — no new decision made, just an already-recorded condition + protocol §9 doctrine applied.

**Where**:
- `brain/scripts/review/deny-set.mjs` (NEW, 66 lines) — pure `isAllowedLabel(label)` predicate + `assertAllowed(labels)` (throws on first denied label, checks the WHOLE batch) + async `guardedLabelAdd(vcs, { project, number, labels })` (the chokepoint: calls `assertAllowed` THEN `vcs.labelAdd`). ALLOW: exact `decision`/`needs-ruling` + prefix `seq:`/`reviewed:`. Everything else denied, including unknown labels not in the deny examples (allow-list is the fence, not a blacklist).
- `brain/scripts/review/deny-set.test.mjs` (NEW, 33 tests) — table-driven over DENIED = [`status:approved`, `size:exception`, `skip:memory-gate`, `override:main`, `kind:whatever`] and ALLOWED = [`decision`, `seq:1`, `reviewed:approved`, `reviewed:stale`, `needs-ruling`]; each denied label proven refused via `assertAllowed` throw AND via `guardedLabelAdd` with a spy `vcs.labelAdd` that THROWS if reached (proves zero-call, not just unasserted); each allowed label proven to pass through to a real spy `vcs.labelAdd` call. Plus: unknown-label fail-closed test, whole-batch-refuses-on-one-denied test, empty-array no-throw test.
- `brain/scripts/review/poster.mjs` (MODIFIED, +10/-4) — imports `guardedLabelAdd` from `./deny-set.mjs`; the anti-stale branch's `await vcs.labelAdd({ project, number, labels: [STALE_LABEL] })` became `await guardedLabelAdd(vcs, { project, number, labels: [STALE_LABEL] })`. Module header comment updated to document the fold (standing condition 1, cites comment 5004345710) and drops the now-stale "general deny-set lands in H1-5" note.
- `brain/scripts/review/poster.test.mjs` (MODIFIED, +58) — 4 new tests: (1) source-scan proving poster.mjs imports/calls `guardedLabelAdd` and contains NO bare `vcs.labelAdd(` call; (2) "poster fold guard" — imports the real `guardedLabelAdd` poster.mjs now uses and proves it refuses a hypothetical denied label (`status:approved`) before a throwing spy `vcs.labelAdd`, proving the fold is the real chokepoint, not cosmetic; (3) end-to-end anti-stale test confirming `reviewed:stale` still applies (spy `labelAdd` sees exactly `['reviewed:stale']`) after the fold — behavior unchanged.
- `openspec/changes/issue-266-h1-brain-review/tasks.md` — task 13.1 checked off with a note documenting the standing-condition-1 fold happened in the same slice. Tasks 12.1 (queue), 13.2 (board), 13.3 (cli wiring) left UNCHECKED — explicitly H1-5b scope, NOT touched.

**Learned**: `needs-decision` (the not-yet-scoped escalation-inbox label from the H1-5 "Not-yet-scoped candidate" note in tasks.md) is deliberately NOT in the H1-5a allow-list — that's H1-5b's own scoping pass, out of this slice. The allow-list must be checked as a fail-closed ALLOW-LIST, not framed as a blacklist of the 4 named loosen/unlock labels — an unknown label (e.g. `kind:whatever`) must ALSO be refused, which is why `isAllowedLabel` returns `false` for anything not explicitly matched rather than only checking against a `DENIED` set. `assertAllowed` checks every label in the batch (not just the first) so a mixed batch like `['decision', 'status:approved']` refuses the whole call — no partial apply. `poster.mjs`'s `STALE_LABEL` constant stays hardcoded to `'reviewed:stale'` (always allowed, matches `reviewed:*`) — the fold could not be proven by making poster itself emit a denied label (it never does, by design), so the "guard" test instead imports the exact `guardedLabelAdd` function poster.mjs now calls and proves refusal with a fresh spy, which is the strongest available proof that the chokepoint poster shares is the real one.

**Status**: 3 local work-unit commits (strict TDD RED→GREEN per module, `feat(review)`/`docs(sdd)` conventional messages, no AI-attribution trailers) on `feat/issue-266-h1-5a-deny-set`, unpushed, no PR opened (orchestrator runs a fresh review first). Full `npm test`: 1645/1645 green (was 1609 baseline on this branch, +36 new tests: 33 deny-set.test.mjs + 3 net-new poster.test.mjs). `npm run repo:check` clean. Counted budget (`git diff origin/issue-266..HEAD --numstat | node brain/scripts/vcs/diff-size-count.mjs`, impl only, `**/*.test.mjs` excluded per `governance.ignoreList`): **80/400** — well under budget, no `size:exception` needed. Per-file: `deny-set.mjs` 66, `poster.mjs` +10/-4 net 14.

### TDD Cycle Evidence
| Task | Test File | Layer | Safety Net | RED | GREEN | TRIANGULATE | REFACTOR |
|------|-----------|-------|------------|-----|-------|-------------|----------|
| 13.1 deny-set allow/deny | `deny-set.test.mjs` | Unit | N/A (new) | ✅ Written (module absent — ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND) | ✅ Passed (33/33) | ✅ 5 denied labels × 3 assertions + 5 allowed labels × 3 assertions + 3 fail-closed/batch/empty cases | ✅ Clean |
| 13.1 standing condition 1 (poster fold) | `poster.test.mjs` | Unit | ✅ 12/13 baseline (source-scan test RED as expected, rest green) | ✅ Written (source-scan asserted guardedLabelAdd absent) | ✅ Passed (46/46 after fold) | ✅ 2 cases (fold-guard refusal + end-to-end reviewed:stale still applies) | ✅ Clean |

### Test Summary
- **Total tests written**: 36 (33 deny-set.test.mjs, 3 net-new poster.test.mjs)
- **Total tests passing**: 1645/1645 (full suite)
- **Layers used**: Unit (36)
- **Pure functions created**: 2 (`isAllowedLabel`, `assertAllowed`); 1 async chokepoint wrapper (`guardedLabelAdd`)

Session: H1-5a deny-set + poster fold slice, continues the H1-1..H1-4 chain (obs #934, #941, #948).
